profile.headline: Software Developer @ LLNL
profile.summary:
Hi! I am a Software Developer with a keen interest in cloud infrastructure and back end development with experience in full stack development. Having a background in information systems analysis and a Bachelors in Computer Science from Cal State East Bay I am excited to pursue my passion in technology.

Most recently, I am working as a Software developer at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory where I work on technologies such as database schema design, API development, CI/CD pipelines, Angular UI implementation, and AWS cloud infrastructure.

I am a reliable, trustworthy, and loyal team player and leader, with a proven track record of success and innovation. I am also a strong advocate for mental health and physical well-being, and I enjoy staying active through working out and outdoor activities. I am always eager to learn new skills, explore new challenges, and create positive impact through technology.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.insights: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +6 skills

positions.title: Department Information Systems Analyst I
positions.locationName: French Camp, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Resolved 1800+ support tickets in 10 months by assisting with system and network hardware/software issues.
- Promoted excellent customer service and team collaboration, resulting in consistent positive performance reviews.
- Developed PowerShell scripts to automate PC imaging tasks, streamlining deployment of 100+ PCs.
- Utilized Python and RestAPI to automate monthly reports on hardware warranties from Zoho Manage Engine.
- Tested and documented SmartVault software, then communicated its use cases and functionality to stakeholders.
- Led meetings with management and vendors to resolve ATIMS software bugs, reducing inmate booking delays.
- Edited Arista Web Filter to block malicious sites and control web access for specific departments.
- Monitored Arista Proxy to detect and prevent viruses from malicious sites through web traffic analysis.
- Worked with vendors to restore servers affected by process freezes.
- Prepared weekly reports to update team and admin on accomplishments and goals.

positions.title: Business Information Analysis Student Trainee
positions.description:
- Configured laptops and desktops for new city employees.
- Assisted in creating user documentation, manuals, and process flows.
- Supported PMWeb integration by migrating city Oracle data for testing.
- Managed and updated Trello boards to support project workflows.
- Conducted user acceptance testing of PMWeb for seamless functionality.
- Coordinated project tasks with team members and consultants to meet deadlines.
- Led end-user training and provided ongoing support for new processes.
- Created a data dictionary to clarify PMWeb terminology for users.
- Tested email triggers and validations for permit submissions in Accela.
- Resolved data discrepancies and error tickets in Accela.
- Utilized SQL queries to analyze GIS data.
- Reconciled GIS data to ensure accuracy for audits
positions.insights: Project Management, Software Documentation and +3 skills
